name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a splash of milk, and whisk with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula as they cook.
Remove from heat while still slightly runny; they will finish cooking from residual heat.
Toast the bread until golden and butter it lightly.
Spoon the scrambled eggs over the toast and serve immediately.

name: Garlic Butter Rice
steps: Cook the rice and keep it warm.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice and toss to coat in the garlic butter.
Season with salt and stir for 2 minutes.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve hot.

name: Tomato Egg Stir-Fry
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a pan and scramble the eggs until just set; remove and set aside.
Add chopped tomatoes to the pan and cook until softened.
Season with a little sugar, salt, and soy sauce.
Return the eggs to the pan and stir together for 1 minute.
Garnish with green onion and serve over rice.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Melt butter in a pan and sauté sliced mushrooms until golden.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss the drained pasta in the sauce and serve hot.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Use cold, day-old rice for the best texture.
Heat oil in a wok and scramble the egg; set aside.
Sauté diced onion, carrot, and garlic until softened.
Add the rice and toss over high heat for 3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and return the egg to the pan.
Garnish with green onion and serve.

name: Potato Soup
steps: Peel and dice the potatoes and onion.
Melt butter in a pot and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add the potatoes and 3 cups of water; simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 5 more minutes and serve warm.

name: Caprese Sandwich
steps: Slice the bread, tomato, and mozzarella.
Drizzle olive oil over the bread slices.
Layer tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil leaves.
Season with a pinch of salt.
Close the sandwich and press gently.
Serve fresh, or toast in a pan for a warm version.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Dice the chicken, carrot, and onion.
Sauté onion and garlic in a pot until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Pour in 4 cups of water and add the carrots; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook until tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

name: Avocado Egg Salad
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool and peel them.
Chop the boiled eggs into small pieces.
Mash the avocado in a bowl with lemon juice.
Mix in the chopped eggs, salt, and pepper.
Toast the bread.
Spread the avocado egg mixture over the toast and serve.

name: Stir-Fried Broccoli and Garlic
steps: Cut the broccoli into bite-sized florets.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat sesame oil in a pan and add minced garlic.
Add the broccoli and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and season with salt.
Toss well and serve as a side dish.

name: French Toast
steps: Whisk together eggs, milk, sugar, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Dip each slice of bread into the mixture, coating both sides.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Cook each slice for 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm.
Top with honey or fruit if desired.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Rinse the lentils under cold water.
Sauté diced onion, carrot, and garlic in a pot until soft.
Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomato, lentils, and 4 cups of water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and serve warm.

name: Cucumber Salad
steps: Thinly slice the cucumber and red onion.
Place them in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Season with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Toss gently to combine.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Cheese Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them set slightly.
Sprinkle grated cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette over the cheese.
Cook for another minute and slide onto a plate.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt.
Melt butter in a pan and cook the chicken until golden.
Add minced garlic and fry for 1 minute.
Mix honey and soy sauce, then pour into the pan.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve over rice.

name: Banana Smoothie
steps: Peel the banana and break it into chunks.
Add the banana, milk, yogurt, and honey to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and add more honey if desired.
Pour into a glass.
Serve cold.

name: Onion Soup
steps: Thinly slice the onions.
Melt butter in a pot and cook the onions slowly for 20 minutes until caramelised.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 3 cups of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with toasted bread and melted cheese before serving.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Cut the broccoli and carrot into small pieces.
Heat olive oil and sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Toss in the drained pasta.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Egg Fried Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to the package and drain.
Heat sesame oil in a wok and scramble the egg; set aside.
Sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the noodles and toss over high heat.
Pour in soy sauce and return the egg.
Garnish with green onion and serve.

name: Baked Potato with Cheese
steps: Wash the potatoes and pierce them several times with a fork.
Bake at 200°C for 45 minutes until soft.
Cut a slit in the top and fluff the inside with a fork.
Add butter, salt, and pepper.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the top and let it melt.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve.
